kicker: Q2 FY27 results scorecard · 2,215 companies with margin data
title: Sales grew in every sector. Margins went nowhere.
dek: With the results deadline past, the median company grew revenue 16.9% year on year, but its operating margin moved just +0.1 points.

chart.title: Median revenue growth by sector, Q2 FY27 vs Q2 FY26
chart.sub: bar colour = median change in operating margin

stats.label: Half widened margins, half didn't
stats.note: 1,118 of 2,215 widened operating margin year on year; the rest held or shrank.

stats.label: Autos & components
stats.note: The fastest sales growth of any sector, yet the median margin slipped. 144 companies reported.

stats.label: Capital goods
stats.note: The largest group (499 companies): strong order-led growth with flat margins.

read: Growth came through at the top line but not into margins: costs and pricing absorbed most of it, so earnings grew roughly in line with sales.
sources: Vantage analysis of Q2 FY27 results filed on BSE (consolidated where available), as of 18 Nov 2026
notes: Revenue growth and operating (EBITDA) margin are year on year, Q2 FY27 vs Q2 FY26, using each company's filed results. Medians, so a few large companies do not move the number. Banks and financial services are left out because their 'operating margin' is not comparable; sectors shown are the 14 with the most results filed. Open Results on the dashboard for every company.
